metadata.title: I Ching (Yijing) Bagua and 64 Hexagrams - Octal-Mapped Dataset
metadata.description: Strictly web-sourced dataset of the 8 Bagua trigrams and 64 hexagrams of the I Ching, mapped to an octal system where one trigram = 3 bits (octal digit 0..7) and one hexagram = two trigrams = 6 bits (octal pair '00'..'77').
sources: Wikipedia - List of hexagrams of the I Ching (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_hexagrams_of_the_I_Ching)
Compart.com - Unicode block U+4DC0..U+4DFF Yijing Hexagram Symbols (https://www.compart.com/en/unicode/block/U+4DC0)

octal_mapping_convention.first_digit: upper trigram (top 3 bits of the 6-bit value)
octal_mapping_convention.second_digit: lower trigram (bottom 3 bits of the 6-bit value)
octal_mapping_convention.bit_to_line: Within each trigram: bit 0 (LSB, value 1) = top line, bit 1 (value 2) = middle line, bit 2 (MSB, value 4) = bottom line

metadata.sorting: Hexagrams sorted ascending by octal_pair (equivalently, by binary value, equivalently by Fu Xi / Shao Yong binary-sequence number).
metadata.note_on_sequences: King Wen sequence is the traditional book order (1..64). Fu Xi (Earlier Heaven / Xiantian / Shao Yong) sequence is the binary order used here for sorting. Each row records BOTH sequence numbers.
metadata.data_provenance: All names, pinyin, English translations, Unicode codepoints, trigram elements, attributes and directions were retrieved directly from Wikipedia and Compart.com web pages via the page_reader tool. No values were taken from internal model memory.

hexagrams.unicode_name: HEXAGRAM FOR DARKENING OF THE LIGHT
HEXAGRAM FOR THE KEEPING STILL MOUNTAIN
hexagrams.other_translations: "keeping still, mountain" and "stilling". The symbol also means, "blunt, tough, and chewy like hard leather"

hexagrams.unicode_name: HEXAGRAM FOR WORK ON THE DECAYED

hexagrams.other_translations: "the corners of the mouth (providing nourishment)", "jaws" and "comfort/security"
"the taming power of the great", "great storage", and "potential energy"
"the abyss " (in the oceanographic sense) and "repeated entrapment"

hexagrams.unicode_name: HEXAGRAM FOR DIFFICULTY AT THE BEGINNING

hexagrams.other_translations: "dispersion (dissolution)" and "dispersal". The symbol means dissipate, dissolve, vanish
"the marrying maiden" and "returning maiden". Marrying younger sister. Not being in a position to make things happen one's own way. Trying to anyway will only bring trouble
"the power of the great" and "great maturity"
"opposition" and "perversion". The symbol 睽 also means separated, estranged, and stare
"possession in great measure" and "the great possession"
"preponderance of the great", "great surpassing" and "critical mass"
